description: ADO-PERSIST/ADO-DISCONNECT with XML: a client static batch-optimistic Recordset of SELECT ID, Code, V, V2, S FROM W ORDER BY ID (read/write copy) has S of row 1 changed, row 2 deleted and a row inserted (ID 40, Code "w40"), and is saved as XML (file kept) and closed; the file is reopened connectionless with adCmdFile (State, RecordCount, each row's Status, S, OriginalValue and UnderlyingValue); ActiveConnection is set by reference to the read/write Connection (State) and UpdateBatch(adAffectAll) is called (Errors); then the Recordset property "Unique Table" is set to "W" and UpdateBatch called again (Errors); the rows again and the stored rows through Execute. Asks whether pending changes survive the file and whether a reopened recordset can submit them.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
